notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first succeeded fully - Shopify storefront (theme 'nkuku-rebuild/production/D2C'), Cloudflare-fronted but no bot block; robots.txt fetched at https://www.nkuku.com/robots.txt (standard Shopify robots, no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow, only default disallows on /admin,/cart,/checkout,/search etc; not a full-site block). curl with a real Chrome UA returned full server-rendered HTML for homepage, all collection pages, and the Shopify products.json API - no Playwright/Chrome needed. TREE: built from union of (1) homepage mega-menu (menu-drawer HeaderDrawer-* nodes covering New/Garden/Furniture/Sofas/Lighting/Kitchen & Dining/Accessories/Soft Furnishings/Gifting/Jewellery top nav), (2) each collection page's own on-page link set (diffed against the homepage nav set for cushion-covers/bedroom-textiles/storage-shelving pages - identical, confirming no hidden per-category sub-nav), and (3) sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (781 collection URLs). The sitemap contained ~770 URLs not present in any live navigation path (sale/archived/individual product-line collections e.g. 'adya-linen-duvet-covers','kambali-throws','tussi-cushion-cover-collection', material filters e.g. 'jute-rugs','wicker-baskets', and 3 storage-named orphans 'bedroom-storage'(25 items)/'bathroom-storage'(26)/'decorative-storage'(30)/'all-storage-furniture'(0)) - confirmed unreachable from any nav page including the 'all-storage'/'all-storage-utility' view-all pages, so excluded as non-navigable collection pages per the View-All/Collection URL rule. QTY: Shopify's public /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 endpoint, counted unique 'handle' values per collection (all totals well under the 250 cap so no pagination was needed); cross-checked each product's own 'product_type' field as a classification signal. EXCLUDED (Furniture boundary, not Storage): storage-shelving (39 items: 26 STORAGE FURNITURE/5 SEATING/4 BEDROOM FURNITURE/4 BATHROOM - titles are wardrobes, iron cabinets, chest of drawers, kitchen island - genuine furniture), freestanding-shelves (13, mostly STORAGE FURNITURE), cabinets-sideboards (37, STORAGE FURNITURE/BEDROOM FURNITURE/TABLES), storage-benches (8, SEATING). EXCLUDED (Decorative Accessories boundary): fireside (33 items - mostly candle holders/lanterns/mirrors/christmas decor, only 3 product_type STORAGE - not primarily a storage category). EXCLUDED (Kitchen & Dining boundary): pantry (69 items, majority SERVEWARE/KITCHEN & DINING ACCESSORIES, not primarily storage), table-settings-linens (26 items, product_type KITCHEN & DINING ACCESSORIES; mix of napkin rings/wood coasters/seagrass placemats with only a few linen napkins/runners/tablecloth - majority non-textile so the mixed collection was not recorded as Textile). EXCLUDED (Furniture accessory, not home textile): fabric-swatches (23 items, product_type MAKE TO ORDER - upholstery fabric samples for made-to-order sofas, not a textile product itself). EXCLUDED (View All / non-nav duplicates): furnishings, all-bedroom-linens, all-rugs, all-storage, all-storage-utility, all-kitchen-storage-utility-room. No bathroom-textile categories (towels, robes, shower curtains) exist anywhere in nav or sitemap for this site. Duplicate-URL nodes (blankets-throws and cushion-covers each linked from both 'Cushions & Throws' and 'Bedroom Linens'; decorative-hooks and wine-racks-cabinets each linked from 2-3 different menu branches) were recorded once only, per the duplicate-URL rule. FLAGGED LOW/MEDIUM CONFIDENCE: 'Hooks & Rails' (decorative-hooks, MEDIUM) and 'Wine Racks' (wine-racks-cabinets, LOW) - see per-row flag text for reasoning.
